Penguin Random House’s product page and general reviews supplied plot and audiobook information but did not explicitly establish narrative person, so they were not used as person evidence.
person_note: The quote set repeatedly exposes Tate as a participating first-person narrator, and the authorized opening independently confirms that strand. Whole-book structural research establishes sustained third-person chapters centered on Wren, including early perspective shifts and the substantial Chapter 29 climax, followed by a return to Tate. These are autonomous recurring base-narrative sections rather than dialogue, documents, or an isolated bookend, so the correct label is ALTERNATING. Confidence is medium because the authorized excerpt covers only the first-person opening; the third-person strand is established by detailed commercial chapter guides and an independent full-book ARC review.
